daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is unusually sharp today. Trust those gut feelings—they're pointing you toward something real. Channel this sensitivity into creative outlets rather than overthinking.

weekly.love: Connection energy is real right now. Whether you're partnered or solo, there's an invitation to be vulnerable in ways that feel safe. Someone might be trying to get closer—pay attention to the signs. Your heart knows what it needs.
